decision: Retain current defaults pending one integration follow-up. The 40,960-row draft head is a useful head micro-optimization but already fails the four-category feasibility quality floor; graph capture is bounded by real kernel work and is deprioritized; the K/V-only provider primitive is exact and already used by prompt priming, but accepted-tail advance_state_only wrappers do not currently request it. No public benchmark row changes.

bridgespec_reference.role: mechanism audit reference; not a comparable benchmark baseline

selection_reference.role: source of the tested 40,960-token ordered selection, not the BridgeSpec upstream identity

b1_current_baseline.protocol: ten canonical prompts, D24, greedy, production/BF16, same-session AR exactness; forced C1/K3 uses resident capacity 1 because capacity 8 exceeds 24 GiB on the RX 7900 XTX; automatic C2/K2 uses capacity 2

ownership.reading: Full-process rocprof attribution remains dominated by the existing Q4 and Q6 T16 owners. This is evidence against opening another speculative local/cache GEMV geometry without a narrower stage-local win.

b2_sliced_dflash_head.protocol: one prompt from each canonical category, D24, sequential exact target verification, DFlash2 B4 verification prefix, full 248,320-row Q6 target head versus BridgeSpec 40,960-row sorted token set, temporary compact-ID D2H/host-map/H2D included
b2_sliced_dflash_head.quality_blocker: The restricted head changes draft candidates. Aggregate acceptance and recall regress, and Japanese mean acceptance falls from 1.8462 to 1.0909. More cycles erase part of the per-call head win. This already fails the four-category feasibility quality floor, so promotion is rejected without spending the final ten-prompt plus heldout gate.
b2_sliced_dflash_head.native_batch_verifier_blocker: The B4 native verifier diagnostic returned INT_MAX token sentinels on the RX 7900 XTX; the binding B2 comparison therefore used the exact sequential target verifier. This is a separate existing diagnostic-path blocker, not evidence for the sliced head.

b3_complete_dflash_graph.protocol: real DFlash2 weights, fixed B8 geometry, context 32, ten measured cycles after two warmups; native 5-layer forward plus full-vocabulary top16 and selector; output-head scoring excluded because B2 measured it separately
b3_complete_dflash_graph.decision: Deprioritize graph capture. About 93% of profiled cycle wall is real device kernel time, bounding ideal launch-only upside to roughly 4.5% of unprofiled wall and ruling out the claimed 5.7x graph compression. Reopen only if DFlash becomes a competitive product route or kernel reductions expose a materially larger host/launch gap.

b4_provider_catchup.protocol: Qwen3.8 trailing NextN blk.64, twelve exact accepted-tail updates, existing full-block control versus existing kv_write_only branch, followed by full logits/top16/state check
b4_provider_catchup.decision: Mechanism confirmed and primitive already implemented. Review found prompt priming requests kv_write_only=True, but accepted-tail advance_state_only and advance_state_only_device wrappers do not. Qualify that integration before calling the opportunity exhausted; do not write another catch-up kernel.

correctness.b1: 20/20 ten-prompt arm cells exact and engaged across C1/K3 and automatic C2/K2
correctness.b2: full and slice target outputs exact to same-session AR on all four categories; candidate quality regressed for slice
correctness.b3: deterministic path hash across all measured cycles
correctness.b4: byte-exact cache, full logits, top16, selected token/logit, and final state

limitations: The RX 7900 XTX has 24 GiB; C1/K3 used resident capacity 1 rather than the W7900 capacity-8 diagnostic because capacity 8 OOMs on this card.
B1 family totals cover complete AR+MTP processes and establish current ownership, not stage-exclusive MTP kernel attribution.
B2 is the required four-category feasibility gate, not the final ten-prompt plus heldout promotion suite; its quality regression already rejects promotion.
The DFlash2 model files were downloaded from the pinned Apache-2.0 snapshot and remain local cache artifacts, not repository content.

Post-commit review found the B4 primitive is not yet requested by accepted-tail advance_state_only wrappers; the original “already implemented” conclusion was correct at the primitive level but too broad at the route-integration level.
